title: Simultaneous Computation with Multiple Prioritizations in Multi-Agent Motion Planning
abstract: arXiv:2501.10781v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-agent path finding (MAPF) in large networks is computationally challenging. An approach for MAPF is prioritized planning (PP), in which agents plan sequentially according to their priority. Albeit a computationally efficient approach for MAPF, the solution quality strongly depends on the prioritization. Most prioritizations rely either on heuristics, which do not generalize well, or iterate to find adequate priorities, which costs computational effort. In this work, we show how agents can compute with multiple prioritizations simultaneously. Our approach is general as it does not rely on domain-specific knowledge. The context of this work is multi-agent motion planning (MAMP) with a receding horizon subject to computation time constraints. MAMP considers the system dynamics in more detail compared to MAPF. translated_title: 多智能体运动规划中基于多重优先级的同时计算方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2501.10781v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：在大型网络中进行多智能体路径寻找（MAPF）在计算上具有挑战性。MAPF的一种解决方法是优先级规划（PP），即各智能体根据其优先级依次进行规划。尽管优先级规划是一种计算高效的MAPF方法，但其解的质量在很大程度上取决于优先级的设定。现有的优先级设定方法要么依赖启发式规则（其泛化能力较差），要么通过迭代来寻找合适的优先级（这会消耗额外的计算资源）。在这项工作中，我们展示了智能体如何同时基于多重优先级进行计算。我们的方法具有通用性，因为它不依赖于特定领域的知识。这项工作的背景是在计算时间约束下具有滚动时域的多智能体运动规划（MAMP）。与MAPF相比，MAMP更细致地考虑了系统动力学特性。在MAMP的数值实验中，我们证明了我们的方法能够实现接近最优的优先级设定，并且优于现有的方法。
tldr: 提出了一种通用的多重优先级同时计算方法，使智能体无需依赖特定领域知识即可在计算时间约束下实现接近最优的优先级设定，从而显著提升多智能体运动规划的解质量。
en_tdlr: Proposes a general simultaneous computation approach with multiple prioritizations, enabling agents to achieve near-optimal prioritization without domain-specific knowledge, thereby improving solution quality in multi-agent motion planning under computation time constraints.
